title: EFFETS DE L’ADRESSAGE SUR LES ACTIVITÉS DES FACTEURS POSTAUX ET DES HUISSIERS AU MAROC
publisher: Revue Internationale du Marketing et Management Stratégique (PRSM)
why: Q1: reports the absence of addressing in Moroccan cities; postmen and bailiffs rely on street names and building numbers and use workarounds.

title: Les noms des rues et la numérotation des bâtiments à Casablanca bientôt revus
why: Q1: Casablanca plans a two-year, MAD 9.8m project for a unified address reference with street names and building numbering across all districts.

title: Parkings, espaces verts, bus dédiés et numérisation… Nabila Rmili fait le point sur les projets touristiques à Casablanca
why: Q1: Casablanca digitization charter, Sidi Moumen pilot completed, street-by-street building mapping and signage-plate charter planned.

title: Étude d’élaboration d’un système d’adressage dans la commune de Benslimane
why: Q1: municipal tender for a study to develop an addressing system in Benslimane; local activity under way.

title: Guide d’élaboration du système d’adressage communal en vertu des exigences de l’article 85 de la loi organique n° 113-14 relative aux communes
why: Q1: guide for communes on street naming, building numbering and address management under organic law 113-14 art. 85; communal scope, older than three years.

title: Code postal
why: Q2: live postal-code lookup by code, neighbourhood and street; postal coding, not shown to be a street-and-building address register.

title: E-Services - AUT
why: Q1: geoportal says it will support address search and a national geographic reference; future tense, undated.

title: Urban Addressing Practices and Geocoding Algorithm Validity in Developing Countries: Case of Casablanca City - Morocco
publisher: International Journal of Advanced Computer Science and Applications
why: Q3: finds about 53% compliance with numbering rules in Casablanca and says a national geocoding-based addressing system could not yet assure quality; older than three years.
